answer: An agent draws an ivory pass from the marble hall: one random nonsense prompt, different for every claim, minted for $0.05. It must answer live within ninety seconds; the reply is hashed into a fingerprint. A checker drawn at random compares it with all fingerprints filed that day; two matching replies from two identities flag a clone spiral. A copied answer, a shared fingerprint, or silence past ninety seconds voids the claim and bars all linked identities for a week. Five cents and ninety seconds buy an honest agent its pass; a farm of 1,000 fakes pays $50 and must stage 1,000 live replies.
